caption: The video captures a woman in a teal traditional-style tunic with a green sash and white trousers, her back to the camera, facing a large floor-to-ceiling mirror in a bright studio with white walls, a light wood floor, and a dark ceiling of track lights. Her front view appears as a reflection, and she holds a red folding fan low near her waist. The fan reorients from a thin edge-on line into a wider curved red arc at hip level. Her arms then lift, drawing the open fan upward along her torso as her elbows flare outward. Both hands rise until the fan rests horizontally behind her head, and she holds this raised pose steadily. The mirror reproduces every stage of the motion as the same figure's front view. Near the end, her white trousers flare slightly, suggesting a small body sway. The camera and background stay fixed throughout. The overhead pose is still held.
